native_direction_authority: Original data-wmode=1 and finite advanceX==0, advanceY>0 per source occurrence; metadata is zipped with that occurrence through canonical sorting. Neither a text/category guess nor bank-title selection.
ambiguity_abstentions: Unknown/nonfinite/missing/nonvertical source advances in a frame prevent whole-frame restoration.
Unknown/invalid source bounds, partial intersections, conflicting source aliases, unrepresented sources, intersecting nonnested enclosures or overlapping claims abstain.
